4.  PG Listing Rules and Obligations (For Owners)

PG Owners must ensure that all listing information is accurate, current, and not misleading. This includes rent price, deposit amount, available rooms, amenities, food offerings, location, and house rules.
The following types of listings are strictly prohibited on the Platform:
Listings for properties that do not physically exist
Duplicate or inflated listings for the same property
Properties involved in ongoing legal disputes
Listings that discriminate on the basis of religion, caste, gender, or nationality in violation of Indian law
Properties without owner's consent or legitimate authority to list

All photos uploaded must be genuine images of the actual property. Use of stock photos, AI-generated images, or photos from other properties is strictly prohibited and may result in immediate listing removal and account suspension.

Owners are required to update bed and room availability within 48 hours of a vacancy being filled. Failure to maintain accurate availability information may result in suspension of the listing or account.
The listed rent price must be the actual amount charged to tenants. Hidden fees, charges not disclosed in the listing, or bait-and-switch pricing practices are prohibited.

PG Owners are solely responsible for the safety, habitability, and legal compliance of their property. This includes compliance with local municipal regulations, fire safety norms, and any applicable licensing requirements in Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
Seekers must make inquiries in good faith. Sending bulk inquiries without genuine intent, spamming PG owners, or misrepresenting identity when contacting owners is strictly prohibited.
Seekers agree to provide valid identification (Aadhaar, PAN, or passport) to PG owners upon request as part of the standard accommodation process. Providing false documents constitutes fraud.

Roommate matching features are provided for informational purposes. Roommat Living does not guarantee compatibility between matched users. Users are responsible for independently verifying the suitability of any potential roommate.

Any tenancy or accommodation agreement entered between a Seeker and a PG Owner is a private contract between those parties. Roommat Living is not a party to such agreements and bears no liability for their terms or execution.
Creating a standard PG listing on Roommat Living is free of charge. Free listings include standard visibility and basic inquiry features.

The Owner Pro Plan is available at Rs.499/month (or as updated on the Platform). This subscription includes featured listing placement, vacancy dashboard, WhatsApp lead alerts, and digital agreement tools. Subscription fees are charged in advance and are non-refundable.
Paid boost packages (ranging from Rs.99 to Rs.299) are available for enhanced visibility. Boost fees are non-refundable once the boost period has commenced.

Where bookings are facilitated through the Roommat Living payment gateway, a commission of 3–5% of the first month's rent may be charged. This fee will be clearly disclosed before any transaction is completed.

Seeker premium plans (Rs.199/month or Rs.399/month) provide additional features including unlimited contact views and AI roommate matching. These are billed in advance and are non-refundable once the billing period has begun.
